card.line: Azekah was a city of Judah in the low hills, where God sent hailstones on Israel's enemies and where Judah later made a last stand against Babylon.

moments.title: Hailstones on the Amorites
moments.text: As the Amorite armies fled from Israel, the LORD cast down large hailstones from the sky as far as Azekah. More of them died from the hailstones than from the swords of the Israelites.

moments.title: Philistines camp near Azekah
moments.text: The Philistines gathered for war at Socoh in Judah and camped between Socoh and Azekah. Israel faced them across the Valley of Elah, and Goliath came out from their camp.

moments.title: One of the last cities standing
moments.text: Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, Lachish, and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.
